name: @alebianco/cr-icons
description: Control Room icon data — path-data packs, one importable map per Iconify family, keyed by the house icon names. Ships the pixel-art escape-hatch pack (pixelarticons) today; add a family = add one @iconify-json/<set> devDep + a name map, run build:icons. CrIcon (in @alebianco/cr-components) renders these; apps can import a map directly and feed any glyph to CrIcon's `path` escape hatch.
